name: Kaigara no Kioku
source:
Listen—if you listen closely, you can hear a faint voice…
Let’s walk through the most beautiful world in the world.

A story about a protagonist who tends to stay indoors, clutching onto memories as they take a walk by the sea.
It’s a story that’s both lonely and incredibly gentle…
